coherent_finiteness: Proved for the specified standard weak elliptic gluing for every q; no extra finite-generation and boundedness assumptions remain in that setting.
quotient_description: Identified as the gluing over the classical singular anticanonical model using BKS Theorem 2.14.
remaining_qgr_comparison: Full faithfulness and essential surjectivity of the induced functor remain unproved for general nontrivial q.
numerical_checks_this_pass: Existing density/zero-wall scripts unchanged and not rerun.
